Rich hand-painted stylized fantasy MMORPG bestiary art, bold clean silhouette and carefully shaded materials. True FRONT orthographic eye-level view facing camera, neutral standing pose, all legs and shell fully within square canvas with wide empty margins. Transparent background with real alpha, no ground, shadow, scenery, floating sparks, writing, border or diagram. Single monster only.
